request.prompt:

This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph with one detail changed. Change only what the instruction names.

Image 1 shows the front of a house with the number 12 beside its door, on a street that faces a park. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same house, street, park, light and framing. Change ONLY two things: the house number plate now reads exactly 8, one single large black numeral, perfectly sharp; and the front door is now painted bright red instead of blue. Nothing else changes.
